newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains fed cattle $65, off $1- USDA, feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains fed cattle $65, off $1- USDA, feedlots.

text.p: U.S. southern and central Plains feedlot cattle near midday Tuesday sold at $65.00 per cwt in light to moderate trading, down $1.00 from last week's top price in that area, according to feedlot sources and USDA.

About 7,300 head of steers and heifers which likely will grade select and choice sold in the Texas Panhandle/western Oklahoma area, USDA said. About 2,000-3,000 head sold in Kansas, with more expected as the day progresses, cattle feeders there said.
But several feedlots continued to pass on packer bids at $65.00.
However, they were expected to follow suit as the market becomes more established, sources said.
